content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a game-changer for digital creators who face challenges with conventional payment systems. Platforms like Gumroad impose hefty fees, often taking up to 10% on each sale. In contrast, NOWPayments' 0.5% fee structure allows creators to maximize their earnings. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can ensure their products are delivered instantly upon payment confirmation, without relying on third-party platforms that restrict access or charge excessive fees. This architecture empowers creators to build their businesses independently, retaining full ownership of both their products and customer data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The underlying architecture for automated ebook delivery consists of several integrated components. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, allowing for automated responses to customer transactions. When a customer makes a payment in cryptocurrency, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain. This process triggers an automated webhook that initiates ebook delivery. The ebooks can be stored using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that the files are accessible only after payment confirmation. This stack is robust yet cost-effective, providing creators with a reliable system to manage sales without the stress of payment rejections or currency fluctuations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where access to conventional payment processors is limited or non-existent. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or digital assets like templates and plugins, this system caters to your needs by providing a reliable method for transactions and delivery. It allows you to focus on creating rather than worrying about payment failures or high transaction fees. By utilizing this architecture, creators can scale their businesses effectively, reaching a global audience without the constraints imposed by traditional payment systems.
Automate ebook delivery with crypto payments to reduce fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of automated ebook delivery relies on a combination of essential components. First, the hosting service, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, provides a free platform for your online store. Next, backend logic is executed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring seamless interaction between the payment processor and the file storage system. NOWPayments serves as the crypto payment gateway, allowing for low-cost transactions and instant confirmation. Finally, Supabase or Google Sheets acts as the database for order tracking, ensuring that all transactions are organized and accessible. Together, these components create a reliable and scalable digital commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your automated ebook delivery system, start by choosing your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment notifications. Integrate NOWPayments to manage cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you select networks with low fees. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store your ebooks securely and set up a delivery method that only activates after payment confirmation. Finally, test your entire system to ensure that orders are processed smoothly and that customers receive their products immediately after payment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack that incorporates automated payment processing through cryptocurrency. This method allows creators to bypass traditional payment platforms, significantly reducing fees and ensuring immediate delivery of products. By deploying tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, you can create a self-sufficient sales system that retains full control over transactions and customer data.
Retain full ownership of your products and customer data.

This kit includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack effectively. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to discover how to implement this powerful infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell an ebook online by using a sovereign digital commerce stack that automates payment processing through cryptocurrency. This eliminates the need for traditional payment platforms, allowing you to retain more of your earnings while ensuring instant delivery to customers.

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to implement a system using NOWPayments and a self-hosted solution like Cloudflare Pages. This approach minimizes transaction fees and allows you to manage your sales independently.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by creating your own digital store that leverages automated delivery and crypto payment processing. This provides full control over your products and earnings.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments compared to Gumroad?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on transactions, significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% fee. This difference can lead to substantial savings, especially at higher sales volumes.
How can I ensure instant product delivery after payment?

To ensure instant product delivery after payment, set up automated delivery systems using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script that trigger when NOWPayments confirms a transaction. This allows customers to receive their products immediately.
